en.benchmarkNotes: Uploaded 800x600 PNG fixture to the dropzone. The reverse alpha engine processed the image instantly with an interactive split comparison slider. Triggered the download action and retrieved a pristine 173,809-byte unwatermarked PNG file at 800x600 with 0ms freeze and 0.00 CLS.
